EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The camera pans over a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor and ladies in flowing gowns rushing to and fro. But amidst the chaos, a peculiar sight catches the eye: the king, a stout and jovial man with a wild shock of white hair, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his loyal subjects.

The king, HE, gazes out at the camera with a far-off look in HIS eyes, a hint of a smile playing on HIS lips. Suddenly, HE speaks in a booming voice, addressing HIS people.

"Friends, subjects, and nobles, I, the great King Reginald, have a vision for our beloved empire. A vision of... of... (HE pauses, searching for the right words)...of futurism!"

The camera zooms in on the king's face, where a look of intense focus is etched. HE begins to gesture wildly, HIS hands waving in the air as HE speaks.

"We shall shed the drab, the dull, and the mundane! We shall don the garb of the future! (HE chuckles maniacally) Behold, the proto-vaporwave aesthetic shall reign supreme!"

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king's advisors, a motley crew of courtiers and scribes, look on in confusion as HE begins to outline HIS vision.

"Firstly, we shall replace the traditional suits of armor with... with... (HE consults a parchment)...with neon-lit, holographic breastplates! And the banners shall be replaced with... with... (HE waves HIS hand)...with holographic projections of our noble crest!"

The advisors exchange skeptical glances, but HE presses on, undeterred.

"Secondly, we shall adorn our castles with... with... (HE gazes up at the ceiling)...with retro-futuristic tapestries! And the gardens shall be filled with... with... (HE smiles)...with glowing, iridescent flowers!"

As HE speaks, the camera pans across the room, showing the advisors' reactions. Some look on in horror, while others seem intrigued.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The camera shows the kingdom in all its new, proto-vaporwave glory. Knights in neon-lit breastplates ride by on holographic steeds, while ladies in flowing gowns wear iridescent headpieces. The banners wave in the wind, displaying holographic projections of the royal crest.

The king, HE, sits upon HIS throne, a look of satisfaction on HIS face. HE gazes out at the camera, a mischievous glint in HIS eye.

"Behold, my friends, the future of our empire! A future of... of... (HE chuckles)...of retro-futurism!"

FADE TO BLACK.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S THRONE ROOM - DAY

The advisors gather around the king, looking on in a mixture of awe and trepidation.

"Your Majesty," says one advisor, "but... but... (HE hesitates)...but what about the, uh, practicalities?"

The king, HE, waves HIS hand dismissively.

"Practicalities, schmacticalities! We shall worry about those later. For now, let us bask in the glory of our proto-vaporwave empire!"

The advisors nod, seemingly resigned to the king's vision. As they disperse, HE turns to the camera, a sly smile spreading across HIS face.

"Stay tuned, my friends. The future is... is... (HE chuckles)...is going to be weird."
